sections.h2: Why Use a Professional Team for Your Wix Site?

paragraphs.text: Wix is a website platform that bundles design tools, hosting, security certificates and an online store in one monthly plan. It is popular because owners can change text and photos themselves. The challenge is that a do-it-yourself Wix site often looks generic, loads slowly or is missing basic SEO settings.

paragraphs.html: Working with a Wix website design company solves that. You get a custom design, a clean page structure and correct search settings from day one, while keeping the freedom to edit later.

sections.h2: What Wix Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Custom Wix Website Design
items.text: Every project starts with your customers and the one action you want them to take, such as calling, booking or sending a WhatsApp message. Our Wix website designer team then creates a layout, colour system and page set that fits your brand rather than a stock template.

items.title: Wix Studio Development
items.text: Wix Studio development suits businesses that need more design control and responsive layouts that adapt cleanly from desktop to mobile. Wix Studio is the platform's advanced editor for designers and agencies, and we use it for sites with more pages, animations or custom sections.

items.title: Wix Velo Development
items.text: Wix Velo development adds custom features using Velo, Wix's built-in JavaScript platform. Examples include custom forms, member-only content, calculators and connections to outside services through APIs. All custom code is documented, so another developer can maintain it later.

items.title: Wix Online Store Design
items.text: Wix online store design gives small retailers a clean product catalogue, simple checkout and order emails, all managed from the same dashboard as the rest of the site. It suits shops with a focused range of products. Prices, photos and stock can also be updated from a phone using the Wix app.

items.title: Wix Multilingual Website
items.text: A Wix multilingual website shows English, Malayalam, Arabic or other languages from one site, with a language switcher and translated pages. A Wix website for GCC businesses can serve English and Arabic visitors side by side.

sections.intro: Our wix website development services cover new sites, redesigns of existing Wix sites, online stores and ongoing care.

sections.h2: Wix SEO Setup and Site Audits

paragraphs.text: Is Wix good for SEO? Yes, when it is set up properly. Wix supports custom page titles, descriptions, clean URLs, sitemaps, redirects and structured data. Most ranking problems come from missing or duplicated settings, not from the platform itself.

paragraphs.html: Our Wix SEO setup covers page titles and descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, redirects from any old site, Google Business Profile links and Google Search Console connection. Because the goal is enquiries, we also place clear calls to action on every page.

paragraphs.text: For existing sites, a Wix site audit checks speed, mobile layout, broken links, SEO settings and page structure. You receive a prioritised list of fixes, and we can carry them out or guide your team through them.

Typical Wix projects include websites for clinics and wellness centres, consultants and accountants, interior designers, tuition centres, cafés, boutique stores and local service firms. Most need the same core pages: home, services, about, gallery, reviews and contact, with a clear WhatsApp or call button on every screen.
Many owners start with a five page site and add a blog, an online store or a second language once enquiries begin to grow.

At launch you receive admin access to your Wix account, a short written editing guide, a recorded training session and a list of every app and setting used on the site. Nothing is held back, so you are never dependent on us for simple changes.

sections.h2: Wix Studio vs Wix Editor and Wix vs WordPress

paragraphs.text: The standard Wix Editor is simpler and suits owners who will make most changes themselves. Wix Studio offers more precise responsive design and suits larger or more design-led sites. We recommend one after discovery, based on who will edit the site.

paragraphs.lead: Wix vs WordPress for small business:
paragraphs.html: Wix includes hosting, security and updates in one plan, so there are no plugins to maintain. WordPress offers more flexibility and suits larger content sites. For a small business that wants low upkeep, Wix is usually the easier choice. For growing content needs, see our WordPress development page.

paragraphs.text: Typical totals: 2 to 3 weeks for a 5 to 8 page business site, and 4 to 6 weeks for an online store or multilingual site.

sections.h2: How Much Does a Wix Website Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does a Wix website cost in India? It depends on the number of pages, languages, store features and custom functions. Wix also charges its own monthly or yearly site plan for hosting and features, billed directly by Wix.
Every design project is quoted after a short discovery call. Each quote from our Wix website design company is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.

items.q: Can I edit my Wix website myself?
items.a: Yes. Wix lets you change text, swap images, add blog posts and update products directly in the editor. We set the site up so layouts stay intact when you edit, and we train your team after launch.

items.q: How long does a Wix website take?
items.a: A 5 to 8 page business site usually takes 2 to 3 weeks. An online store or multilingual site takes 4 to 6 weeks. We confirm the timeline in writing after discovery.

items.q: Do I own my Wix website?
items.a: Yes. The site is created in your own Wix account or transferred to you at launch. You control the domain, content and billing.

Yes. Wix manages hosting, security certificates and platform updates for every site, so there are no plugins or server patches for you to maintain. We add strong passwords, two-step login and role-based access for your team.

items.q: How do I choose a Wix website design company?
items.a: Look at live sites the team has built, check that designers are in-house, and ask how they handle SEO settings and training. A reliable partner gives a fixed written scope and stays available after launch.
